Ontario Premier Doug Ford Apologizes for French Language Skills

Ontario Premier Doug Ford has apologized for his performance speaking French during a recent visit to Montreal. Ford acknowledged that his French "needs work" and described his attempt as "botched." He stated that his effort was a "show of respect" for the French language and culture.
